verdicts.rationale: Both entries have the truncated title 'Iconic arithmetic, vol' (Bricken, Unary Press) but different years: 2019 vs 2021. This is a known multi-volume work (Iconic Arithmetic Vol I 2019, Vol II 2021); the 'vol' fragment plus distinct years indicates different volumes of a multi-volume set, which must be kept separate. Neither is indexed, so stakes are low, but they are distinct publications.

Identical DOI, title 'Depiction, Pictorial Experience, and Vision Science', author Briscoe, year 2016, Phil Topics 44(2):43-81. Briscoe2016 is a Zotero-style key duplicate of the hand key briscoe2016depiction. Only the survivor is deepIndexed.
Identical DOI, title 'Does Perception Have Content?', author Brogaard, year 2014, OUP. Brogaard2014 is a Zotero-style duplicate of brogaard2014does. Only the survivor is deepIndexed.

All three share DOI 10.1080/00048402.2014.948463, title 'Maps and Absent Symbols', author Bronner, AJP 93(1):43-59. bronner2015maps and Bronner2015 are year-shadow/Zotero duplicates of bronner2014maps (the 2015 year is the online-vs-print discrepancy for the same article). Only survivor is deepIndexed.

Same book 'Textbook of evolutionary psychiatry', author Brune/Brüne, 2008, OUP, ISBN 9780199207688. The two keys differ only by citekey spelling (brown2008textbook vs brune2008textbook) and diacritic encoding; brune2008textbook is a duplicate import. Neither indexed.

All three share DOI 10.1080/00048402.2024.2412243, title 'The Priority Map', author Buehler, AJP 103(1):235-260. buehler2024priority (year-shadow key, has_folder) and Buehler2025 (Zotero key) are duplicates of the deepIndexed survivor buehler2025priority. Only survivor is indexed; the folder on buehler2024priority is not independently indexed.

All three share DOI 10.2307/2185131, title 'Individualism and Psychology', Burge, Phil Review 95(1):3, 1986. burge1986tyler and burge1986philosophi are duplicate/shadow keys of the deepIndexed survivor burge1986individualism (the 'Preprint (forthcoming)' note is a stray artifact). Only survivor is indexed.
Identical DOI, title 'Perceptual Entitlement', Burge, PPR 67(3):503-548, 2003. Burge2003 is a Zotero-key duplicate of burge2003perceptual. Only survivor is deepIndexed.

Both are 'Perceptual Objectivity' by Burge, 2009. Survivor burge2009perceptual (deepIndexed) has sparse fields but the loser Burge2009 supplies the full metadata (Phil Review 118(3):285-324, DOI 10.1215/00318108-2009-001) for the same work — a Zotero-key duplicate. Only survivor is indexed.

burge2014, burge2014a (empty shadow key), and burge2014replyblock all correspond to DOI 10.1111/phpr.12136, 'Reply to Block: Adaptation and the Upper Border of Perception', Burge, PPR 89(3):573-583, 2014. The empty burge2014a is a legacy alias; burge2014replyblock is a misc-type duplicate. Same work. None indexed.

burge2014reply, burge2014b (empty shadow key), and burge2014breply all correspond to DOI 10.1111/phpr.12093, 'Reply to Rescorla and Peacocke...', Burge, PPR 88(2):485-501, 2014. Empty burge2014b is a legacy alias; burge2014breply is a misc-type duplicate. Same work. None indexed.

Identical DOI, title 'The Iconic Nature of Perception', Burge, in 'Perception: First Form of Mind', OUP, pp.293-364, Chapter 9, 2022. Burge2022 is a Zotero-key duplicate of the deepIndexed burge2022iconic. Only survivor is indexed.
